reason: I'd want proper evidence that collagen powder actually does anything for my skin or joints before I commit to it monthly, and reviews on the brand's own site don't count as evidence to me. On top of that, an unflavoured scoop every single day sounds like a chore I'd give up on by week two.
objection: Is there any real proof that drinking collagen peptides helps skin, hair or joints, or am I just paying for expensive protein that gets digested like anything else?
would_change_my_mind: Independent clinical studies on this specific dose, plus the halal certifying body named clearly so I can check it myself.
